Kiev–Odessa counter gallery

Actual shared game-engine counter rendering from the current Kiev–Odessa build. Each row shows the full-strength or ready face on the left and the reduced, damaged, or reverse face on the right. Single-sided cavalry counters are labeled as such because the source does not provide a separate reduced-strength face.
